question: In India, a clinical trial may be registered on the Clinical Trials Registry – India (CTRI) after the first patient is enrolled, provided registration is completed within 30 days of enrolment.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. CTRI registration must be prospective — it must occur BEFORE the first patient is enrolled. Retrospective registration is not permitted. This is a mandatory requirement under ICMR 2017 guidelines and DCGI regulations.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. CTRI registration must precede enrolment — it is prospective registration. Registering after enrolment begins is a serious research ethics violation under ICMR 2017 guidelines and DCGI regulations.
